title: Cyclic Projective Orbits on Rational Normal Curves and MDS Codes
summary: Let \(A\) be a cyclic operator on an \(r\)-dimensional vector space over a field \(k\), and let \(z\) be a cyclic vector. Their Krylov code has parity-check matrix \((z,Az,\ldots,A^{n-1}z)\). For \(r\ge 3\) and \(n\ge r+3\), we prove that an MDS orbit segment lies on a rational normal curve precisely when the projective pair \((A,[z])\) is conjugate to one arising from the \((r-1)\)-st symmetric-power action of \(\mathrm{PGL}_2\).
